results.description:
Even if his heart no longer beats, Tyron will not be stopped on his path to vengeance.

The Western Province has fallen, its population purged and the survivors have fled over the mountains and into a magick scoured wasteland. No matter how far they go, or how well they hide, the Empire will not rest until the heretics and rebels have been crushed.

Under the fragile leadership of Merigold Herimar, a low ranking noble appointed well above her station, the Golden Legion is massing. If she can fight through the bureaucracy and petty grievances of the court, she may save the Empire.

Tyron, knowing his options are few, must grow stronger and build his undead horde to greater heights. To achieve this, he will need to access the mysterious Realm of the Dead.

Book 5 of the next hit LitRPG series from RinoZ, the author of Chrysalis. Book of the Dead takes on all aspects of Necromancy headfirst, from the tactical manuevering of skeletons, to what it's like spending so much time amongst the undead.
